animSpriteLayer-sprite.label: Sprite
animSpriteLayer-sprite.tip: Select a preset sprite image (in the Animation Settings panel Alt+S)

animSpriteLayer-blend.label: Blend
animSpriteLayer-blend.tip: Select a formula to blend the color with the underlying color

animSpriteLayer-light.label: Light
animSpriteLayer-light.tip: Affects the rendering effect of the image

anchor.name: Anchor Sampling
anchor.tip: Samples light from the image's anchor point to blend the color

global.name: Global Sampling
global.tip: Samples light from multiple pixel locations of the image to blend the color
